note: Delhi drafted a one-time challan amnesty in October 2025, but the cabinet sent it back on 8 December 2025 after legal advice that challans already before courts cannot be waived without judicial approval; it sits with the Law Department for a compliant redraft. No amnesty is in force. Delhi's real settlement routes are the Lok Adalat token system, weekday evening courts and, from 5 July 2026, weekend courts at district court complexes. Under rules reported in May 2026, an e-challan must be paid or contested within 45 days, and contesting in court requires depositing 50% of the fine first.
